string.name: viewer_help
string.value: RTSP/TCP: H.264 and H.265 (8-bit, up to 1080p), select Basic or Digest explicitly. RTMP supports AVC video and AAC-LC audio only; no RTMPS, HEVC or account authentication. Audio starts muted. Public HLS (.m3u8) and HTTP-FLV (.flv) use the system player; codec support varies. For protected FLV, Basic is sent only on the selected URL; redirects are blocked. Use cleartext HTTP/RTSP/RTMP only on trusted networks. Voice goes only to the selected HTTP(S) device; choose ADTS for older Harmony receivers.
